[Act: insolvency
 Chapter: Liquidation Process
 Section: 46::Relevant period for undervalued transactions.
]


(1) In an application for 3[avoidance of an undervalued transaction], the liquidator or the resolution professional, as the case may be, shall demonstrate that—
(i) such transaction was made with any person within the 4[period starting from] one year preceding the 5[initiation date and ending on the insolvency commencement date]; or
(ii) such transaction was made with a related party within the 4[period starting from] two years preceding the 5[initiation date and ending on the insolvency commencement date].
(2) The Adjudicating Authority may require an independent expert to assess evidence relating to the value of the transactions mentioned in this section.
